name: Source yield and exploration policy
purpose: Spend sourcing effort where it produces eligible BA/remote opportunities while preserving discovery outside Profesia.

allocation.explorationFloor: Every required source family remains checked; no family is dropped solely for low recent yield.
allocation.priorityBoost: Increase query depth for families producing BA/remote eligible, non-duplicate leads in the last 7 days.
allocation.deprioritize: Reduce repeated near-identical queries when a family has high duplicate/hard-gate rejection rates, but preserve the exploration floor.
allocation.profesiaCap: Profesia may remain a high-yield family but cannot consume the non-Profesia exploration budget.
allocation.blockedSources: Blocked/limited sources such as public Facebook receive truthful status and a separate access-recovery backlog; zero verified hits are never converted into synthetic yield.

successDefinition: A source is valuable when it produces a concrete, canonical, currently active opportunity that passes BA/remote, language, hard-skill and minimum-value gates—not merely search-result volume.
safeWriteRule: This policy changes sourcing/query allocation only; it must not rewrite locked UI, CRM, baseline, stable IDs or existing job records.
